3490-4659-6824-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6824-8319.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-6254-8249--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-6254-8249--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1531-1580-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-1580-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Deathgreeter and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

826-1636-6495-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
826-1636-6495-6935.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

261-1981-2415-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2412-2523-2869.description:
Activate Crosis's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Crosis's Attendant dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Crosis's Attendant that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Crosis's Attendant token

1017-3532-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Falco Spara.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

2440-5115-7082-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it. Then, activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2440-5115-7082-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

372-2556-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2556-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1061-4603-6965.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-6965.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-6965.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2921-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2921-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1494-2871-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-2871-4613-7152.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-2871-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Seething Anger. Seething Anger is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1479-2841-3875-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-3875-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3259-5734-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2438-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1355-1978-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1355-1978-3263.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat

1805-1978-4694.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat

539-3045-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5226.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5226.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-4050-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-4050-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2292-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2292-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

654-1170-3389-5921-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

573-774-3470.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3470-4693-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3470-4693-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

2999-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2999-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3099-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Soliton.
3099-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1335-2265-2445-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1335-2265-2445-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting four +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid and Marath, you may use them to get infinite green mana, Elemental creature tokens, and +1/+1 counters, and/or deal infinite damage to any target(s).

215-3000-4289-4541-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasures.
215-3000-4289-4541-5295.description:
Activate eight Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate two Squirrel tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-3742-4872.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
1309-3742-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that is tapped and attacking.
Salvager of Secrets enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

738-1969-2034-3652.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
